verses.text_en: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the Most High, and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.
verses.text_hr: Pazite na nebo, sinovi neba, i na svako djelo Svevišnjega, i bojte ga se i ne činite zlo u njegovoj prisutnosti.

verses.text_en: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?
verses.text_hr: Ako On zatvori nebeske prozore i spriječi kišu i rosu da siđu na zemlju zbog vas, što ćete tada učiniti?

verses.text_en: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: Ako zbog vaših djela pošalje na vas svoj gnjev, nećete Ga moći moliti, jer ste protiv Njegove pravednosti govorili ohole i drske riječi; zato nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en: And see ye not the =sailors= of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?
verses.text_hr: I zar ne vidite =mornare= brodova, kako njihove brodove valovi njišu tamo-amo, kako ih vjetrovi tresu, i kako su u velikoj nevolji?

verses.text_en: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.
verses.text_hr: I zato se boje jer sav njihov imetak odlazi na more s njima, i imaju zle slutnje u srcu da će ih more progutati i da će u njemu nestati.

verses.text_en: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the Most High, and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?
verses.text_hr: Zar cijelo more i sve njegove vode, i svi njegovi pokreti, nisu djelo Svevišnjeg, i zar On nije postavio granice njegovim djelima, i zatvorio ih u cijelosti pijeskom?

verses.text_en: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.
verses.text_hr: Na Njegov prijekor more se uplaši i presuši; ugibaju sve njegove ribe i sve što je u njemu. Ali vi grešnici na zemlji ne bojite Ga se.

verses.text_en: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?
verses.text_hr: Nije li On stvorio nebo i Zemlju i sve što je na njima? Tko je dao razum i mudrost svemu što se miče na zemlji i u moru?

verses.text_en: Do not the =sailors= of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the Most High.
verses.text_hr: Zar se =mornari= na brodovima ne boje mora? Ipak, grešnici se ne boje Svevišnjega.
